annotations.title: Change a Microsoft Advertising bid strategy

description: Change a Microsoft Advertising campaign’s BID STRATEGY, read back: EnhancedCpc, MaxClicks (maxCpc cap), MaxConversions (optional targetCpa), MaxConversionValue (optional targetRoas), TargetImpressionShare (targetImpressionShare + targetAdPosition). Search takes any; Audience EnhancedCpc / MaxConversions; Shopping EnhancedCpc; Performance Max MaxConversions / MaxConversionValue. TargetCpa and TargetRoas are sent as MaxConversions / MaxConversionValue with the target, which is what Microsoft converts them to since 2025-08-04. Conversion strategies need a UET tag and a conversion goal recording conversions. On a LIVE campaign it needs confirm:true. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

biddingScheme.description: new bid strategy; TargetCpa and TargetRoas are sent as MaxConversions and MaxConversionValue

campaignId.description: Microsoft campaign id whose bid strategy changes

confirm.description: REQUIRED true on a LIVE campaign

maxCpc.description: bid cap in account currency, for MaxClicks and MaxConversions

targetAdPosition.description: FirstPage, MainLine or MainLine1 (MainLine1 = very top), with TargetImpressionShare

targetCpa.description: target cost per conversion in account currency, for MaxConversions

name: set_microsoft_ads_bidding
title: Change a Microsoft Advertising bid strategy
